title: MGMem: An Efficient, Deterministic, and Provenance-Preserving Framework for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.33174v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents need persistent memory that surfaces the right past interaction at the right time across thousands of turns. Many systems index by invoking generative LLMs to rewrite history into summaries, facts, or knowledge graphs--a step that is (a) costly (thousands of generative calls per build), (b) non-deterministic (undermining reproducibility and giving inconsistent answers across runs), and (c) provenance-erasing (the reader sees synthesized text, not the original turn). We propose MGMem, a framework with no generative indexing calls that replaces this step with a deterministic discriminative-parser pipeline: recurring mentions across sessions are organized into an incidence graph, question mentions are resolved by a subject-conditioned three-stage resolver, and raw dialogue episodes are returned to the reader. translated_title: MGMem：一个高效、确定性且保留来源信息的长程智能体记忆框架
translated_abstract: 长程大语言模型智能体需要持久化记忆，能够在数千轮交互中在恰当的时机呈现正确的过往对话内容。许多系统通过调用生成式LLM将历史改写为摘要、事实或知识图谱来进行索引——这一步骤存在以下问题： 高昂（每次构建需要数千次生成式调用）， 非确定性（损害可复现性，导致不同运行之间给出不一致的答案）， 丢失来源信息（读者看到的是合成文本，而非原始对话轮次）。我们提出MGMem，这是一个无需任何生成式索引调用的框架，它用确定性的判别式解析器流水线取代了这一步骤：跨会话反复出现的提及被组织成关联图，问题中的提及通过主体条件化的三阶段解析器进行消解，原始对话片段被直接返回给读者。在英文多会话对话问答任务上，MGMem在相同实验协议下超越了基线方法。
tldr: MGMem是一个无需生成式索引调用的确定性长期记忆框架，通过判别式解析器流水线和关联图组织跨会话记忆，在成本、可复现性和来源信息保留方面优于现有方法。
en_tdlr: MGMem is a deterministic long-horizon memory framework that eliminates costly generative indexing calls by using a discriminative-parser pipeline and incidence graphs, outperforming baselines in efficiency, reproducibility, and provenance preservation.
